steps.sql: select l.id, l.email, l.source_tool, l.intent, l.stack_recommendation from leads l left join clicks c on c.lead_id = l.id where c.id is null and l.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' and not exists (select 1 from nurture_sends ns where ns.lead_id = l.id and ns.sequence_step = 'reengagement-0');

steps.instruction: Write a short re-engagement email using the source tool and intent. Never name a brand. Return subject and html.

steps.sql: insert into nurture_sends(lead_id, sequence_step) values ({{id}}, 'reengagement-0') on conflict do nothing;
